name: Qld Net
summary: Gold Coast dial-up ISP (Qld Net Pty Ltd, Ashmore QLD). Feb 1997 qldnet.com.au portal offered the classic small-ISP service set: free software downloads, a web-page generator, 'AUTOFAX EMAIL', an 8 GB 'CACHE SURF' proxy browser, hosted classifieds, and Gold Coast/Brisbane weather. Two /23-scale 1997 allocations. Absorbed by Chariot Ltd around 2004 in its Queensland consolidation: by Mar 2005 qldnet.com.au was rebranded as Chariot's Queensland 'netconnect' portal, with qldnet.com.au a customer mail domain.
aliases: Chariot netconnect (QLD portal brand, from c. 2004)

events.details: Existing as an ISP by 9 Feb 1997: qldnet.com.au captured by the Wayback Machine showing a full customer portal (newspapers, classifieds, game downloads, free software, web-page generator, AUTOFAX EMAIL, 8-gigabyte CACHE SURF, links and weather).

events.details: 1997 APNIC-era allocations: QLDNET-AU 203.16.60.0-203.16.61.255 and QLDNET1-AU 203.31.164.0-203.31.165.255, registered to Qld Net Pty Ltd, Ashmore QLD, per the 1997 IP Network Index (InterNIC whois extract).

refs.label: IP Network Index 1997 (ipindex.net, retropc mirror): QLDNET-AU, QLDNET1-AU

events.details: Absorbed by Chariot Limited (ASX: CTI) in its Queensland consolidation. Qld Net does NOT appear in Chariot's FY2003-04 acquisitions list (annual report: Blue Pin Internet, Squirrel Net, Pipeline Internet, Penalva, Internex, Speedlink, One Earth, Ledanet, Broadnet, Satlink) — so it was acquired in FY2004-05. By 25 Mar 2005 qldnet.com.au served Chariot's Queensland portal rebranded 'Chariot netconnect' (Chariot Limited ABN 31 088 377 860), announcing the 'integration of recently acquired ISPs in QLD' (Leadanet, Broadnet) and a Gold Coast office relocation (Sep 2004); the webmail dropdown lists the absorbed QLD mail domains (qldnet, technet2000, better.net.au, mackay.net.au, northnet, picknowl, oznetcom, mrbean, ledanet, broad.net.au).
